title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00007 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Waited for altus and maersk mechanic to fix grease pump. Achieved good test of 345 bar on lubricator, but pump still not working as it should. Grease pump stroke increased rapidly due to pump not able to deliver enough grease pressure.
00:45 - 01:00: Attempted to open HMV and equalizing manifold to pressure up lubricator with n2 and displace starlube and MEG into well. Unable to open HMV due to error in HMV pump.
01:00 - 02:00: Waited while altus fixed HMV pump. Most likely caused by air in pump system.
02:00 - 02:35: Opened HMV and injected n2 in lubricator and bullheaded MEG/STARLUBE mix into well. Meanwhile, grease pump started to work properly again.
02:35 - 02:55: Closed HMV and bled off pressure in lubricator.
02:55 - 03:05: Broke lubricator and added 80 l starlube in riser.
03:05 - 03:30: Stabbed lubricator and filled rig-up with MEG. Attempted to leak test rig-up, but grease pump was unable to deliver grease pressure.
03:30 - 08:30: Altus worked on grease pump issue with maersk mechanic and electrician.
08:30 - 14:00: Grease pump OK. Waited for approval from onshore organisation if OK to RIH.

16:00 - 17:55: Closed DHSV and bled down pressure in tubing to 3 bar.

sections.text: Waited for altus and maersk mechanic to fix grease pump. Achieved good test of 345 bar on lubricator, but pump still not working as it should. Grease pump stroke increased rapidly due to pump not able to deliver enough grease pressure.
Attempted to open HMV and equalizing manifold to pressure up lubricator with n2 and displace starlube and MEG into well. Unable to open HMV due to error in HMV pump.
Waited while altus fixed HMV pump. Most likely caused by air in pump system.
Opened HMV and injected n2 in lubricator and bullheaded MEG/STARLUBE mix into well. Meanwhile, grease pump started to work properly again.
Closed HMV and bled off pressure in lubricator.
Broke lubricator and added 80 l starlube in riser.
Stabbed lubricator and filled rig-up with MEG. Attempted to leak test rig-up, but grease pump was unable to deliver grease pressure.
Altus worked on grease pump issue with maersk mechanic and electrician.
Grease pump OK. Waited for approval from onshore organisation if OK to RIH.
Leak tested lubricator to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Opened HMV
Equalized and opened DHSV. WHP 62 bar. Observed leakage in o-ring on x-over between XMT and lower riser.
Closed DHSV and bled down pressure in tubing to 3 bar.
Inflow tested DHSV to 59 bar DP for 30 min.
Bled off remaining pressure in tubing to 0 bar
Closed HMV and purged lubricator with n2.
Broke lubricator and l/d BHA w/ tractor) on drill floor.
Disconnected lower riser from x-over and liftet riser section and BOP using top drive with double securing. Changed o-ring on x-over and stabbed riser back onto x-over.
Disconnected XMT from x-over and liftet riser section and BOP using top drive with double securing. Changed o-ring on x-over and stabbed riser back onto XMT. One of the o-rings had some small marks.
Closed shear ram on BOP and leak tested between SV and BOP to 200 bar for 10 min.
Lifted lubricator and GIH and hung it off above riser section using rig crane and top drive.
M/u BHA for run w/ tractor).
